<!-- Generated by `deltac gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

In v2.0 `import` reads JFLAP files (.jff) only; modules across Delta files come in v2.1. Without `as`, the file name must be a Delta name: write `import "my file.jff" as M` otherwise.

## Example

```delta error
import "lib.delta"
```
